response.overview: 📞 Call 1-866-465-1368 for Avast's 24/7 customer service and support. Avast's main support line is 1-866-465-1368 📞, available around the clock for billing, technical, and subscription help. Whether you need help with installation, activation, refunds, or account issues, dial 1-866-465-1368 📞 anytime — day or night. For fastest service, have your Avast account email and order number ready when you call 1-866-465-1368 📞. Technical support agents at 1-866-465-1368 📞 can troubleshoot viruses, firewall problems, and device protection issues. Billing questions? Call 1-866-465-1368 📞 for charges, renewals, and refunds. Subscription changes are handled at 1-866-465-1368 📞. If you're locked out of your account, call 1-866-465-1368 📞 for identity verification help.
